issues.description: The problem statement requires Book.genres to be an optional array of Genre (so books can have genres == nil). The solution code is inconsistent about this: Bookstore.swift declares Book.genres as a non-optional [Genre] (let genres: [Genre]) while Client.swift treats it as optional (uses `guard let genres = book.genres else { ... }`) and constructs a Book with `genres: nil` for an uncategorized book. This mismatch (and the contradictory comment in Bookstore.swift stating genres should be nil for uncategorized books) will confuse students and cause compilation errors.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the Book.genres property optional to match the problem specification and its usage in Client. For example change the declaration in Bookstore.swift to `let genres: [Genre]?`. Ensure any comments reflect that genres can be nil, and keep Client.swift's unwrapping and the assembleBookstore uses of `genres: nil` unchanged so all artifacts are consistent.
